title.narrative: Reducing Food Insecurity and Undernutrition with Electronic Vouchers Project

description.narrative: With more than 4 out of every 10 Filipinos facing moderate to severe food insecurity, the project aims to reduce hunger and enhance access to nutritious food for poor and vulnerable households. It will support the expansion of the government's new flagship social assistance program—the Walang Gutom (Zero Hunger) Food Stamp Program (WGP)—providing monthly electronic food vouchers to 750,000 food-insecure households nationwide, alongside nutrition-sensitive social and behavior change communication (SBCC) sessions. The project will also help strengthen implementation capacity and enhance shock-responsive social protection systems, ensuring the timely delivery of food vouchers to safeguard food and nutritional security amid growing climate and disaster risks.
